set.body:
FOLLOW-UP (T4) from S5 (bd-01M19XMQN4VK4WSTVSHBD3X1YB). ADR 0020 §8 copies MappingExchange's private CellType/Column/Table/quote/validUtf16 into StoryModelExport, to avoid editing G2's file during the push. Two copies of one wire can drift.

Acceptance: a private[codec] quoted-TSV/v1 writer used by both. Byte-identical output for both bundles: the committed examples/mapping/miniature and examples/storymodel-export/war-of-the-ghosts must be unchanged, and both Python readers must pass. Coordinate with the mapping exchange owner before editing mappingexchange.scala.
set.title: [follow-up] codec: one quoted-TSV/v1 table writer shared by MappingExchange and StoryModelExport
